7751f5ce4661e326e5b9: You become stronger by surviving encounters, learning from your mistakes and crossing seas that seemed impossible. But growing does not just mean dealing more damage: a Navigator can learn to read unfamiliar currents, a Doctor can perfect their healing and a Captain can find the courage to lead the crew against a much stronger enemy.
02f18182db6999b97563: In Grand Line Chronicles, character growth follows different paths:
f7370641d0ad8eceeb58: Ability Points (AP) allow Attributes, Skills and abilities that expressly declare they use them to be developed.
2f1a443efdd48a63a1d5: Custom Techniques follow the limit of the Attribute used.
2b7a0bc182d30dda9ccd: Upgrades represent major moments of growth in the story and grant resources, AP and Talents.
ab762cf8ae08269537e4: Fruit and Haki follow their respective narrative progressions.
a5f08139610810ed9eb1: These systems work together, but are not the same thing. A pirate can perfect their abilities through experience without waiting for an Upgrade. Conversely, an Upgrade grants benefits not obtained simply by accumulating AP.
